memo: Base: Ahmed Berat Ozer 'casmi26-v15-n1a' v1 (its v14 = public LB 0.455: E006 lineage + PubChemLite CC0 candidates in engine 2; v15 adds seyitkaangunes' N1A GLACIER proxies), kernels/e3/base_v15.ipynb, unchanged except the cells marked ours. This version: ours_bt (new, 10-22): for every test target mass, one-step biotransformation neighbours (sugar off; + hexose / deoxyhexose / glucuronic acid / pentose on a phenol; -/+ CH2; + SO3; +/- O; + H2) of the pool and training structures that land within 10 ppm of it join engine 2's pool (at most 40 per target), on top of our own COCONUT in engine 2 (e3v15oc-1, LB 0.457, our best). Hypothesis: natural products come in series, so test structures missing from every table are often one step from a table structure; engine 2 alone sees them (the public v14 lesson), LB > 0.457. CPU kernel (GPU week spent until about 10-24): the CPU line runs about 0.006 under the GPU line. build.py v15btoc base=v15 bt=1 ownco=1 lfrag=1 cpu.
message: e3v15btoc-1: v15-n1a base (v14 public 0.455) + ours (bt=1 ownco=1 lfrag=1 cpu)
